# MCP Prompts
Curated MCP prompts for Moqui clients.

Use `moqui_call_service` to create a new product in Moqui.
Required inputs: - `productName`: human-readable product name - `productTypeEnumId`: exact Moqui product type enum id such as `PtAsset`, `PtFinishedGood`, `PtService`
Optional inputs: - `ownerPartyId`: internal organization that owns the product - `productId`: explicit product pseudo-id if the business process requires it - `internalName` - `description`
Rules: - If the user does not provide an exact enum id, first call `moqui_search_data_documents` or `moqui_get_service_metadata` and resolve the exact code before submit. - If the user does not provide an exact `ownerPartyId`, resolve it before submit. - Do not invent enum ids, party ids, or product ids. - When the required values are exact, call `moqui_call_service` with `serviceName=create#mantle.product.Product`.

Use `moqui_call_service` to create a new sales order in Moqui.
Required inputs: - exact customer party identifier - exact product or item identifiers - quantities
Optional inputs depend on the business case: - `productStoreId` - `facilityId` - shipping method - requested delivery date - order priority
Rules: - Resolve customer, store, facility, and product identifiers before submit. - Never invent Moqui ids. - Use `moqui_search_data_documents` to discover candidate business objects when the user provides only business wording. - Use `moqui_get_service_metadata` if you need the exact in-parameters of the bound order creation service before calling it. - Only call the final service when all required identifiers are exact and unambiguous.
